newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan foreign minister flies to Malaysia - TV.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan foreign minister flies to Malaysia - TV.

text.p: Taiwan Foreign Minister John Chang flew to Malaysia on Friday, a day after he returned from a secretive trip to Indonesia, state television reported.

"John Chang's trip is very secretive. He uses an alias to avoid the media," Taiwan Television said. The visit is sure to anger China, which says Taiwan is a renegade province not entitled to any international contacts.
Both Malaysia and Indonesia recognise China instead of Taiwan, which have been separated since a civil war in 1949.
"John Chang is expected to return to Taipei at 2300 local time tomorrow," the television said. It did not give sources for the information.
Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas has confirmed that he met with Chang in Jakarta on Wednesday, but stressed that he had done so in an individual capacity.

Chang's trip to Indonesia followed Taiwan Vice-President Lien Chan's secret visit to the Ukraine last month. Beijing has accused the former Soviet republic of violating the "one China" commitment it made in establishing bilateral ties.
